file_roles.evidence: getTableFromSingletonPool returned 'pool.getTable(tableName);' bare and leaked whatever HTablePool threw. It gains 'throws IOException' and an unwrapping catch, 'catch (RuntimeException t) { // handle cases that an IOE is wrapped inside a RuntimeException like HTableInterface#createHTableInterface if(t.getCause() instanceof IOException) { throw (IOException)t.getCause(); } else { throw t; } }'. The trace fails on exactly that line, 'at org.apache.phoenix.util.ServerUtil.getTableFromSingletonPool(ServerUtil.java:151)', with 'Caused by: java.lang.RuntimeException: org.apache.hadoop.hbase.TableNotFoundException: SYSTEM.STATS'.

rationale: The message the user saw is built in the gold file, 'Error: org.apache.hadoop.hbase.DoNotRetryIOException: SYSTEM.CATALOG: org.apache.hadoop.hbase.TableNotFoundException: SYSTEM.STATS at org.apache.phoenix.util.ServerUtil.createIOException(ServerUtil.java:84)', and the frame that failed is also in it, ServerUtil.java:151. HBase's HTableFactory wraps the TableNotFoundException in a RuntimeException, and the helper passed that straight to callers that declare and expect IOException, as the unchanged neighbour shows: 'public static HTableInterface getHTableForCoprocessorScan (RegionCoprocessorEnvironment env, HTableInterface writerTable) throws IOException'. Correcting that unwrapping is the whole change.
notes: A second rater could reasonably call this symptom-handling: the entire diff is a try/catch added at the frame where the failure surfaced, and the condition it reports on, a missing SYSTEM.STATS during an upgrade from 4.0.x to 4.2.2, originates in the upgrade path, which the packet never shows. It is labelled causal because ServerUtil owns this helper and its declared IOException contract, so returning a wrapped RuntimeException is the wrong logic, and no other file was changed (rubric rule: if nothing elsewhere was treated as broken, the unguarded code is the defect). Worth putting in the agreement check. Most of the pasted trace is third-party: HTablePool, HTableFactory, HConnectionManager, HRegionServer and RpcServer are HBase classes; the only project-owned frames outside the gold file are MetaDataEndpointImpl, which was not changed.
